ns2:course.label: Acting Studio III: Voice
ns2:course.description: (THEAT 255) Advanced training in voice and speech for the stage with emphasis on classic texts.. Enrollment limited to Theatre majors. 2 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: THEA 375, THEA 376, THEA 377 and THEA 378, and concurrent registration in THEA 471, THEA 473 and THEA 474.
